name: Qwen-Image-2.1 Multiple Angles
description: Reshoot any photo from 36 camera angles with one LoRA

paragraphs: A Gradio Workflow (node-based canvas) that reshoots any photo from a controlled camera position: feed a photo, pick an azimuth and elevation, get the same subject from that angle — with the first camera-control LoRA for Qwen-Image-2.1 (akhaliq/Qwen-Image-2.1-Multiple-Angles-LoRA).

Everything is inlined into this Space — unlike split MiniMax-H3 deployments, Qwen-Image-2.1's DiT + Qwen3-VL text encoder + RGBA VAE fit one ZeroGPU Space, so there is no remote conditioner call. The canvas wires a Photo reference into the bound reshoot function (@spaces.GPU), with knob references for azimuth (12 labels), elevation (4 labels), close-up, steps, seed and LoRA strength — the same grammar the LoRA was trained on ( {azimuth}, {elevation}[ close-up]).

The inference wiring (pipeline-level loadloraweights, startup CUDA placement, the vision patch-embed Conv3d→matmul optimization) follows Viggle's Qwen-Image-2.1 turbo workflow Space by @akhaliq — credited where it saved real time (30 s per reference image).
